Notes About

Afnan perfumes and colognes

Country: United Arab Emirates
Main activity: Fragrances
Brand website: link

Afnan Perfumes, started in 2007 by Imran Fazlani in the United Arab Emirates, has made a name for itself in the fragrance scene. From the beginning, it tapped into the rich traditions of Middle Eastern perfumery, mixing that heritage with a fresh, modern twist to craft luxurious scents that reach people worldwide.

The brand’s lineup covers a wide range of tastes, with options for men, women, and unisex wearers. Its 9AM/9PM series stands out, offering lively, crisp scents for the day and deeper, striking ones for night. The Supremacy collection brings rich, lavish aromas that often remind people of pricier fragrances. Then there’s the Bouquet collection, full of elegant floral blends, and Turathi, which leans into classic Middle Eastern notes like oud and musk. Scents like Supremacy Not Only Intense and 9PM highlight Afnan’s knack for blending oriental, spicy, and vanilla tones into something versatile.

Afnan sits in the global market as a luxury brand that’s easy to get your hands on, often praised for giving a budget-friendly spin on designer-style perfumes. That’s won it a loyal crowd who love quality without the hefty price tag. While some folks mention the scents don’t always last as long as they’d hope, Afnan keeps its edge with solid craftsmanship, eye-catching packaging, and a creative take on what a fragrance can be, holding its own as a lively contender in the perfume world.

Designer Afnan has 137 perfumes in our fragrance base. The earliest edition was created in 2012 and the newest is from 2026. Afnan fragrances were made in collaboration with perfumers Lucas Sieuzac, Quentin Roussel, Imran Fazlani, Gaël Montero and Jean-Louis Sieuzac.
